dialogue.origin: こんにちは。お時間になったら始めさせていただきます。よろしくお願いいたします。
dialogue.content: Hello. We'll get started now that it's our scheduled time. It's nice to meet you.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは。宜しくお願い致します。
dialogue.content: Hello. It's nice to meet you too.

dialogue.origin: 今日は相談に来ていただきましてありがとうございます。初めにご年齢、性別、呼んでほしいお名前、ご相談内容を教えてください。
dialogue.content: Thank you for coming in today. To start, please tell me your age, gender, what you’d like to be called, and what brings you in.

dialogue.origin: 中学2年 女子 さきでいいです。毎日もう嫌だな、もういいかなと思ってます
dialogue.content: Second year of junior high, female. Saki is fine. Every day I feel like I’ve had enough—like maybe I’m done.

dialogue.origin: さきさん教えていただきありがとうございます。さきさんは中学２年生でおられて、毎日が嫌だと感じられているのですね。
dialogue.content: Thank you for sharing that, Saki. So you're in the second year of middle school, and you're feeling that every day is just unbearable.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: なるほどそれはお辛いですね。
dialogue.content: I understand, that must be very painful for you.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 何があったんでしょうか？よければ私に教えてもらえませんか？
dialogue.content: What has been happening? If you're comfortable, could you tell me about it?

dialogue.origin: 何も楽しいことがないし、毎日しんどいし、何のために生きてるのか分かりません
dialogue.content: There's nothing fun, every day is just exhausting, and I don't know what I'm living for.

dialogue.origin: それは辛い毎日に感じますよね。
dialogue.content: That would make each day feel very painful.

dialogue.origin: しんどいしかないです
dialogue.content: It's nothing but exhausting.

dialogue.origin: なるほど気持ちが少しづつでもはれるといいですよね。特に何をしている時がつらく感じられますか？
dialogue.content: I see. It would be nice if you could find some relief, even a little bit. Is there any particular time when you feel it's the hardest?

dialogue.origin: はれません。毎日しんどいです。どうしたらいいですか？
dialogue.content: I can't find any relief. Every day is exhausting. What should I do?

dialogue.origin: 何もしていません。毎日寝て起きて。夜は嫌で寝れないし、昼はずっとねています
dialogue.content: I’m not doing anything. I just sleep and wake each day. I dread the night and can’t sleep, and I end up sleeping all day.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。学校は行っていますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Are you able to go to school?

dialogue.origin: いけません
dialogue.content: I can't go.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。それは気持ちがよけいに沈んでしまいましね。
dialogue.content: I see. That must make you feel even more down, doesn't it.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 夜寝れないのがしんどい
dialogue.content: Not being able to sleep at night is exhausting.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、お昼外に出ないと夜眠りづらくなりますね。時間が長く感じますよね。
dialogue.content: I see. If you don't go outside during the day, it becomes harder to sleep at night. Time must feel like it's dragging on.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 昼間は外に出るの怖い
dialogue.content: I'm scared to go outside during the day.

dialogue.origin: 昼間出るのがどういう所が怖く感じますか？
dialogue.content: What is it about going out during the day that feels scary?

dialogue.origin: 同級生に会いたくない
dialogue.content: I don't want to run into my classmates.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それは出ずらく感じますね。同級生に何かされましたか？
dialogue.content: I can see how that would make it difficult to go out. Did something happen with your classmates?

dialogue.origin: 無視される
dialogue.content: They ignore me.

dialogue.origin: 無視されているように感じるわけですね。特に固定の人はいるんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you feel you’re being ignored. Is there anyone specific?

dialogue.origin: 部活のメンバー
dialogue.content: The club members.

dialogue.origin: それは困りますね。部活のメンバーが特に嫌な感じなんですね？たとえば具体的にどういう風にとか教えてもらえますか？
dialogue.content: That must be very upsetting. So it's the members of your club that are making you feel this way? Could you tell me more specifically what happens, for example?

dialogue.origin: 元々仲の良かった子から急に距離を置かれて
dialogue.content: A girl I was originally good friends with suddenly started keeping her distance from me.

dialogue.origin: そこから他の子も同じ感じです
dialogue.content: After that, the other kids started acting the same way.

dialogue.origin: 仲のいい友人にそんな風にされたら悲しいですね。他にメンバーにも距離を置かれているように感じているわけですね。
dialogue.content: It must be so sad to be treated like that by a close friend. And you feel that the other members are keeping their distance from you too.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 辛い気持ちでそれから過ごしてこられたのですね。そのときにどうしたのか聞いてみましたか？
dialogue.content: You must have been living with such painful feelings since then. Did you try asking her what was wrong?

dialogue.origin: はい。先生に間に入ってもらって話合いしました。でも、その子とは今はもう仲良くしたいと思ってないです
dialogue.content: Yes. We had a teacher mediate a discussion. But now, I don't want to be friends with that girl anymore.

dialogue.origin: 私の事誰も分かってくれないし
dialogue.content: And besides, nobody understands me.

dialogue.origin: その理由はさきさんは納得できないものだったんでしょうか？他のメンバーも全員そのお友達側に付いてるように感じておられるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Was the reason she gave something you couldn't accept? And do you feel like all the other members are siding with her?

dialogue.origin: イツメンの4人も学校来たら喋るって言ったのに、誰も話しかけてくれなかったし
dialogue.content: My usual group of four friends said they would talk to me if I came to school, but no one approached me.

dialogue.origin: 納得出来なかったです。私だけみんなと違うから分からないのかもとも思ってます
dialogue.content: I couldn’t accept it. I also think maybe I just don’t get it because I’m different from everyone else.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね、それは不信感を持ってしまいますね。みんなと違うと思う点はどういう点でしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. That would certainly make you lose your trust in them. In what way do you feel you're different from everyone else?

dialogue.origin: 何回も裏切られてしんどい
dialogue.content: Being betrayed over and over is exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 皆は部活しかしてないけど、私はやりたいことがあって、週末はあまり部活に行ってません。
dialogue.content: Everyone else is just focused on the club, but I have other things I want to do, so I don't go to club activities much on the weekends.

dialogue.origin: 他にも裏切られたと感じる嫌なことがあったのですか？よければ吐き出してみてくださいね。
dialogue.content: Have there been other times when you felt betrayed and hurt? Please feel free to vent about it if you'd like.

dialogue.origin: 頑張って修学旅行だけ行ったけど、同じ部屋の3人の部活の子が私だけはみごにしてました
dialogue.content: I forced myself to go on the school trip, but the three other club members in my room completely left me out.

dialogue.origin: 頑張って行った大会でも話しかけてくれなかった
dialogue.content: They didn't talk to me at the competition I pushed myself to go to, either.

dialogue.origin: 教室に頑張って行った時も同じ部活の子は、誰も話しかけてくれなかった
dialogue.content: When I made an effort to go to the classroom, none of the club members spoke to me either.

dialogue.origin: それは辛いくていやですよね。さきさんが気持ちを分かってもらえないと感じるのは当然に思えますね。
dialogue.content: That must have been so painful and unpleasant. It's completely understandable that you feel like nobody gets what you're going through.

dialogue.origin: 毎日しんどい
dialogue.content: Every day is exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 部活以外でお話できる人はいますか？部活以外の時は何をしていますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anyone you can talk to outside of your club? What do you do when you're not involved in club activities?

dialogue.origin: 今は学校に行ってないから誰とも話してないです
dialogue.content: I'm not going to school right now, so I don't talk to anyone.

dialogue.origin: 他に中の良かった子も、他にも仲のいい子いるから
dialogue.content: Other kids I was friendly with have other good friends, so...

dialogue.origin: そうでしたね。時間が空くと入りづらく感じますよね。春からはどうされるご予定ですか？
dialogue.content: That's right. When you've been away for a while, it can feel difficult to go back. What are your plans for this spring?

dialogue.origin: わかりません
dialogue.content: I don't know.

dialogue.origin: 学校行きたいけど、怖くて行けない
dialogue.content: I want to go to school, but I’m too scared to go.

dialogue.origin: 春からも不安に感じておられるのですね。中学の部活のメンバーも同じ学校になりそうなんでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you’re feeling anxious about spring as well. Do you expect the members from your junior high club to be at the same school?

dialogue.origin: 学校は同じです
dialogue.content: We go to the same school.

dialogue.origin: 話しかけてくれた子もいるけど、ずっと一緒にいるわけじゃないし、1人になるのが怖い
dialogue.content: There are some kids who have talked to me, but they aren't with me all the time, and I'm scared of being alone.

dialogue.origin: それは不安ですよね。話しかけてくれた人に相談とかはされましたか？
dialogue.content: That must be worrying. Have you tried talking about this with the kids who spoke to you?

dialogue.origin: どう思ってるとか怖くて聞けないし
dialogue.content: I'm too scared to ask them what they really think.

dialogue.origin: 皆、自分のこと、どう思ってるのかわかりません
dialogue.content: I don’t know what anyone thinks of me.

dialogue.origin: 先生には相談した事あります
dialogue.content: I've talked to a teacher about it.

dialogue.origin: 確かに自分の事聞くの怖いですよね。先生は何て言われましたか？
dialogue.content: It's definitely scary to ask what others think of you. What did the teacher say?

dialogue.origin: あなたは悪くないし、嫌な事をしたり言ったりするのは、そういう風にしか言えないんだって思ってればいいよって
dialogue.content: They said, 'You're not the one at fault. When people do or say mean things, you can just think that's the only way they know how to be.'

dialogue.origin: そうなんですね。さきさんには非が無かったんですね。先生が理解してくれたんですね。
dialogue.content: I see. So it wasn't your fault. The teacher understood your situation.

dialogue.origin: はいその先生だけは本当の気持ちが言えます。担任は相手にも負担がかかる事だからって、私が話しかけて欲しいって言って欲しいと言ってもダメでした
dialogue.content: Yes, that teacher is the only one I can express my true feelings to. My homeroom teacher, on the other hand, said it would be a burden on the others, and refused when I asked them to tell the other students to talk to me.

dialogue.origin: そんな先生がおられて良かったですね。担任の先生は何故「相手に負担がかかるといわれたのでしょうね？」
dialogue.content: It's wonderful that you have a teacher like that. I wonder why your homeroom teacher said it would be a 'burden on the other students'?

dialogue.origin: はい、良かったです。相手にも、相手の思うことがあるから無理強いできないと
dialogue.content: Yes, I'm glad. They said the other students have their own thoughts and feelings, so they couldn't force them.

dialogue.origin: なるほど。そうであったとしてもそれを聞いてくれるのが先生の仕事だと思いますね。
dialogue.content: I see. Even if that's the case, I feel it's a teacher's job to at least hear you out on that.

dialogue.origin: どうなんでしょうか。悲しかったけど、先生ってそういう立場だからしょうがないのかなと思いました
dialogue.content: I’m not sure. It made me sad, but I thought maybe that’s just the position teachers are in, so it can’t be helped.

dialogue.origin: それ以外にどうしたらいいか分からなくなったけど
dialogue.content: But beyond that, I didn't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: さきさんは大人ですね。担任の先生にそんな風に返されたら、余計クラスに行きづらくなるのもわかりますよ。
dialogue.content: You are very mature, Saki. I can certainly understand how a response like that from your homeroom teacher would make it even more difficult to go to class.

dialogue.origin: 理解してもらえた先生に、今の学校の事、これからの不安などをもう一度相談してみるのはどうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What do you think about talking again with the teacher who understood you, about your current situation at school and your worries for the future?

dialogue.origin: 考え方は大人だと違う人にも言われました。
dialogue.content: Other people have told me that my way of thinking is mature, too.

dialogue.origin: そうですよね。周りの同級生と距離を感じるのもそういうところからかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: I can see that. The distance you feel between yourself and your classmates might come from that.

dialogue.origin: 相談はしていて、いつも親身になってくれます。でも、先生は友達じゃないのでクラスで一緒にはいれません
dialogue.content: I do consult with that teacher, and they are always very supportive. But a teacher isn't a friend, so they can't be with me in the classroom.

dialogue.origin: わかって貰えないと感じるのは、そうかもしれません
dialogue.content: That might be why I feel like I'm not understood.

dialogue.origin: 確かに先生と常に一緒には居れないですものね。周りより成長が早いのはいい事なのですが、周りが付いてきていないのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.content: It's true, you can't be with a teacher all the time. Being more mature than your peers is a good thing, but perhaps they just haven't caught up with you yet.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: さきさん、終了のお時間になりました。まだまだ解決には遠いかもしれませんが、今日はご相談いただいてどうでしたか？
dialogue.content: Saki, our time is up for today. We may still be a long way from a resolution, but how was it talking about things today?

dialogue.origin: 少し落ち着きました
dialogue.content: I feel a bit calmer.

dialogue.origin: でも、状況が変わらないのでどうすればいいか分かりません
dialogue.content: But since the situation hasn't changed, I still don't know what to do.

dialogue.origin: そうですね。解決にはお時間がかかるかもしれません。もしよろしければ続きをご相談にいらしてください。
dialogue.content: That's understandable. It might take some time to find a solution. If you'd like, please feel free to come back and continue this conversation.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: また来ます
dialogue.content: I'll come again.

dialogue.origin: はい、是非！今日はありがとうございました。とりあえず終了させていただいて大丈夫でしょうか？
dialogue.content: Yes, please do! Thank you for today. Is it okay if we end our session here for now?

dialogue.origin: 大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Yes, that's fine.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。では終了いたしますね。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well. I'll end the session now.

topic.sub: 同級生との人間関係問題
